SaveApplying: The changes are being applied to the library in the background.
GenresHelp: On the left, the genres your items will have. On the right, the genres given by your library and the metadata providers, moved into each of them. By default every genre is in the genre of the same name, so nothing changes: move a genre into another one to replace it, rename a genre on the left (renaming it like another one merges them), or delete it to remove its genres from the items. Changes only apply after saving, check them in the Preview tab. Items with locked genres are never changed.
PreviewHelp: The changes the current settings, including the unsaved ones, would make to the items.
CommitHashHelp: Optional, for testing. Loads the web files of the plugin (settings page and translations) from this commit of the GitHub repository instead of the ones bundled with the plugin. Leave empty in normal use.
ResetHelp: Restores the original genres (the ones given by the metadata providers or set by hand) of the items changed by the plugin, without changing any other metadata, and resets the settings so every genre is kept.
ResetConfirm: Restore the original genres of the items and reset the settings?
ResetStarted: The original genres are being restored in the background.
